story-1.text: Winter has passed. Is spring getting closer?

story-2.text: Late at night, I became lost in the forest.

story-3.text: After travelling for a long time, I suddenly discovered an incredible new world.

story-4.text: A girl runs into the classroom, late for class.

story-5.text: Two friends work together on an art project at a table.

story-6.text: Two friends walk out through the school gate together.

story-7.text: Two kids search the park for a ball they lost.

story-8.text: Two friends share an umbrella — and one steps in a puddle.

story-9.text: Two best friends build a blanket fort at a sleepover.

story-10.text: A kid sits in a theater seat, watching the show.

story-11.text: Two friends stand at the edge of the playground, talking.

story-12.text: A girl on a hike stops to drink some water.

story-13.text: Two friends sit face to face at a restaurant table, having lunch.

story-14.text: A girl stops in front of a shop window, looking at something she loves.

story-15.text: A girl draws at a table while her teacher stands beside her, helping.

story-16.text: At midnight, a hand turns the door handle — someone is peeking around the edge.

story-17.text: A girl freezes, hiding behind a cushion — she just heard or saw something scary.

story-18.text: A hand holds a warm mug at the table, next to a plate of food.

story-19.text: One pair of feet walks forward down a school hallway, a door waiting at the far end.

story-20.text: Under the table, one hand passes a secret note to another.
